title: PresentMon same-map renderer-asset reuse comparison

workload.terminal: Windows Terminal maximized; Cascadia Mono 6; 151 rows by 688 columns
workload.scope: Performance replay with a same-map E1M1 reload at tic 1247; it does not complete E1M1 or the campaign.

interpretation.change: On a same-map reset, reuse the persistent renderer workers' static map assets. Continue publishing dynamic world state through the simulation snapshots. Reload renderer assets on a changed-map transition.
interpretation.pacingConclusion: Not qualified. This is one sequential baseline/candidate pair. Active completed updates fell from 49.70 to 46.22 per second; the measured PresentMon transitions were 43.66 and 45.89 per second, both below 60. The simulation rates were 34.97 and 34.97 per second, slightly below 35.
limitations: Single sequential, non-audio comparison; no randomized repeated A/B rounds.
The replay ends at ReplayEnd after 1,560 commands and does not finish E1M1.
PresentMon measures ETW presentation/display events, not optical monitor output or a one-to-one count of unique Doom framebuffers.
The remaining 0.358-second candidate handoff was not separately attributed.
Cold startup, other map loads, full-session audio, campaign completion, 35 Hz pacing and 60 displayed FPS remain unqualified.
